data.title: abrdn Healthcare Opportunities Fund (THQ) and abrdn World Healthcare Fund (THW) Announce New Managed Distribution Policies and Declare Monthly Distributions
data.description: On September 11, 2026, abrdn Healthcare Opportunities Fund (NYSE: THQ) and abrdn World Healthcare Fund (NYSE: THW) disclosed that the Board of Trustees has endorsed managed distribution policies for the Funds. Each Fund will have its independent policy aimed at ensuring regular distributions to investors. This decision means that investors can anticipate a consistent flow of income. It reflects the commitment to providing value to shareholders.

data.title: abrdn Income Credit Strategies Fund (ACP) Announces Change to Monthly Distribution Expected to Be Maintained for at Least the Next 12 Months
data.description: In Philadelphia on September 11, 2026, the abrdn Income Credit Strategies Fund (NYSE: ACP) disclosed a decrease in its monthly distribution, lowering it from $0.0775 to $0.055 per common share. This adjustment will take effect for the distribution scheduled for September 30, 2026, benefiting shareholders of the Fund.

data.title: Hydro One seeks approval from the Ontario Energy Board to build the North Shore Link
data.description: A new power line being constructed in northeast Toronto is anticipated to enhance the electricity system and boost economic development in the region. On September 11, 2026, Hydro One Networks Inc. (Hydro One) and Hydro One Sault Ste. Marie LP (HOSSM) jointly submitted an application to construct the line, aiming to bolster the infrastructure and facilitate growth. This initiative is seen as crucial in meeting the increasing power demands of the area, with the project expected to involve substantial investment and create numerous job opportunities.

data.title: abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (AWP) Announces New Managed Distribution Policy and Declares Monthly Distribution
data.description: Philadelphia, September 11, 2026 - The abrdn Global Premier Properties Fund (NYSE: AWP) disclosed that its Board of Trustees has endorsed a managed distribution policy to offer shareholders a clear distribution structure. This strategy aims to provide an annualized payout rate of $0.25 per share, primarily through monthly distributions. The policy is intended to ensure shareholders receive consistent and predictable income distributions while maintaining the Fund's long-term performance objectives.

data.title: University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies announces 2026 Knowledge Without Boundaries Summit
data.description: A two-day virtual research summit scheduled for October 22-23 will delve into the theme of "Research as Sense-Making in Times of Uncertainty." The event will unite scholars, practitioners, and community partners from various fields. Taking place in Phoenix, the summit is organized by the University of Phoenix College of Doctoral Studies. This marks the 13th edition of the event, which aims to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing among participants.

data.title: abrdn Asia-Pacific Income Fund, Inc. (FAX) Announces New Managed Distribution Policy and Declares Monthly Distribution
data.description: On September 11, 2026, abrdn Asia-Pacific Income Fund, Inc. disclosed that its Board of Directors sanctioned a managed distribution policy. data.title: AstraZeneca Stock Trips On Unexpected Failure In Breast Cancer
data.description: A significant decline in AstraZeneca's stock was witnessed during late trades on Friday due to the failure of the company's experimental breast cancer treatment. The unexpected setback led to a substantial drop in the company's stock value. The unsuccessful trial outcome resulted in a visible stumble for AstraZeneca in the stock market, with investors reacting negatively to the news. This development had an impact on the company's financial standing, reflecting in the final trading numbers. The experimental breast cancer treatment not meeting the required standards had a pronounced effect on AstraZeneca's shares by the end of the trading day.

data.title: WealthStream Adds OpenAI’s GPT-Live-1 to Practice, Launching at Future Proof
data.description: WealthStream, a prominent provider of advice intelligence for the wealth management sector, revealed the integration of OpenAI’s GPT-Live-1 into its Practice solution meant to assist financial advisors in gearing up for client discussions. The launch of Practice is slated for the upcoming week at WealthStream’s Booth 240, Zone 1, during the Future Proof Festival set to take place from September 14 to September 17 in Huntington Beach, California. This innovative offering brings WealthStream's advice intelligence into a dynamic and interactive setting.

data.title: Pan Global Engages Adelaide Capital for Investor Relations Advisory
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia on September 11, 2026, Pan Global Resources Inc. data.title: EverCommerce Announces an Increase and Extension of its Share Repurchase Program
data.description: Today, EverCommerce Inc. (NASDAQ: EVCM) based in Denver disclosed the approval from its Board of Directors for a $25 million expansion of its existing $300 million share buyback initiative. This decision elevates the total approved budget for repurchases to $325 million, which will be in effect until December 31, 2027. EverCommerce Inc. specializes in streamlining operations and fostering growth for small and medium-sized service businesses.

data.title: Maxim Power Corp. Announces TSX Acceptance of Normal Course Issuer Bid
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Maxim Power Corp. (TSX: MXG) disclosed approval from the Toronto Stock Exchange for a normal course issuer bid (NCIB), allowing the Corporation to buy back and cancel up to 3,173,127 common shares (Shares). With 63,462,546 Shares issued and outstanding as of September 2, 2026, the NCIB accounts for roughly 5% of MAXIM's total Shares by that date. The actual number of Shares eligible for repurchase and the buying schedule will be determined by MAXIM. The NCIB includes a daily limit of 2,389 Shares, representing 25% of MAXIM's average daily trading volume over the past six months, set at 9,557. Moreover, MAXIM can conduct one block purchase exceeding daily repurchase limits every calendar week.

data.title: TWO Announces Offer to Repurchase 9.375% Senior Notes due 2030 and Satisfaction and Discharge of the Related Indenture

data.title: PMT Site and Lark Electric Combine Civil and Electrical Capabilities Through American Gridwork Partners
data.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn.-- A new partnership has been formed between PMT Site and Lark Electric, merging their strengths in civil construction and electrical services. This collaboration, under the American Gridwork Partners platform, offers customers a comprehensive infrastructure solution encompassing site development, underground utilities, electrical construction, fiber optics, controls, and automation. By joining forces, the two companies aim to provide a wider range of services to clients across various projects. PMT Site's expertise lies in civil construction, while Lark Electric brings its proficiency in electrical work to the table.
